document: BC Politics in the time of COVID-19: July 2020 Update (Innovative Research Group, 2020-07-29)
note: Last Innovative BC provincial poll before the 2020 election (listed on Wikipedia). Online panel, n=441 unweighted (weighted to n=300). Shares among decided voters (vote + lean) from the 'Decided vote by Region' slide. BCU = BC Liberal. AUTRES = 'Other'. n = bases as printed on the slide (N=160/55/53, appear to be weighted; national decided n=267). Region labels verbatim: Lower Mainland and Fraser Valley, Vancouver Island and Sunshine Coast, Interior and North.
